subject.title: fix: preserve native trace heading typography

question: Should this trace-gated Apple UI change require direct exact-head native rendering proof before merge, or should a maintainer explicitly override that proof requirement because the production trace display path is unavailable?
rationale: Only a maintainer can accept a proof exception for an externally visible Apple rendering change when the submitted structural tests do not show the resulting UI.

options.title: Require native proof
options.body: Request a redacted simulator or app recording from the current head that visibly compares thinking and response headings, including an accessibility Dynamic Type case.

options.title: Explicitly override proof
options.body: Accept the focused structural coverage as sufficient only if a maintainer records why native rendering proof cannot be produced for this trace-gated path.

recommendation.title: Require native proof
recommendation.body: Request a redacted simulator or app recording from the current head that visibly compares thinking and response headings, including an accessibility Dynamic Type case.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the underlying heading behavior, authored this repair, and are assigned to the PR.
